mechanism_narrative: Sustained quarterly growth in GDPC1 (demand) signals expanding economic activity, leading to higher equity valuations and positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 does not rise over the 20-day horizon or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in FEDFUNDS below 1.5% triggers a positive signal as it indicates monetary easing, boosting equity valuations and driving positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS does not cross below 1.5% or 20-day returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous quarterly growth in GDPC1 (demand) and monthly HOUST (demand) signals robust demand expansion, leading to positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns as investors anticipate stronger economic activity.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 and HOUST do not move in tandem or 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: High INDPRO (supply) and low UNRATE (labor) in a late-cycle expansion regime signal robust economic fundamentals, fostering investor confidence and positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: If the late-cycle expansion regime is not met or 60-day returns fail to outperform baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in UNRATE below 3.0% signals labor market tightening, boosting investor confidence and driving positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns as unemployment decreases.
failure_condition: If UNRATE does not fall below 3.0% or 5-day returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising FEDFUNDS coupled with falling PAYEMS (lower unemployment) indicates monetary tightening paired with labor market strength, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS and PAYEMS move in opposite directions or 20-day returns are not positively correlated with the signal.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained monthly growth in INDPRO (supply) indicates robust production capacity, fostering positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns as markets anticipate sustained growth.
failure_condition: If INDPRO does not show sustained growth over the 60-day horizon or returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, rising RSAFS (demand) alongside slightly easing FEDFUNDS signals economic revival, driving positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: If the post-shock recovery regime is not active or 5-day returns fail to outperform baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
